about_the_game:
Add rings and parts representing legendary Japanese pro-wrestler and MMA combatant Yoshihiro Takayama with this Edit Part DLC.

[CONTENTS]
Custom Ring - PWE (Professional Wrestling Emperor)
Custom Ring - TAKAYAMANIA EMPIRE IV
Wrestler Edit Parts - Face (Yoshihiro Takayama)
Wrestler Edit Parts - Hair (Yoshihiro Takayama, blond)
Wrestler Edit Parts - Hair (Yoshihiro Takayama, black ponytail)

All Spike Chunsoft revenue will be donated to TAKAYAMANIA, a foundation established to help support Mr. Takayama and his family.
Mr. Takayama was paralyzed from the neck down from a wrestling accident during a match on May 4, 2017. This is Part 3 of the Charity DLC series in honor of Mr. Takayama.
